text:
pagerbot: ALERT: High 5xx rate (inference-api) in us-west-2a — spikes started ~3050123400, errors at 18% for last minute. Pager routed to @oncall-sre :rotating_light:

oncall-sre: got the page, joining. checking metrics and NLB health now.

alice: seeing increased TLS errors in logs: `TLS handshake timeout` and `connection reset by peer`. A bunch of requests are stuck in `SYN_SENT` earlier.

ben: confirmed across multiple nodes in us-west-2a — p95 latency jumped from 80ms -> 1.1s and error rate to 15-20%. Other AZs (us-west-2b/c) look stable.

carla: are customers hitting 502/503 or just latency? support-bot: multiple customers reporting inference timeouts and degraded streaming. One enterprise customer on Dedicated reported retries and partial outputs.

luca: grabbing `netstat` and `dmesg` from a few impacted pods now. also checking instance-level metrics (ENI TX/RX drops).

alice: `curl` against a known failing endpoint shows:
```
$ curl -v https://api.redwood-inference.com/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"hi"}'
* TCP_NODELAY set
* Connected to api.redwood-inference.com (10.12.4.23) port 443 (#0)
* TLS handshake hangs...
* Connection #0 to host api.redwood-inference.com left intact
curl: (28) Connection timed out after 5000 milliseconds
```

ben: NLB target health shows flapping for targets in us-west-2a, `target.status` toggling Unhealthy/Healthy. ENI metrics show transmit error spikes at same time window.

oncall-sre: taking traffic steering action: enabling regional routing policy to shift new sessions away from us-west-2a to us-west-2b for 90s test window. Will monitor error rates. @carla will you coordinate customer comms?

carla: on it. Drafting short note for affected tenants: "We are observing degraded performance in us-west-2a and routing new requests to nearby AZ; we will follow up with details." Sending now.

luca: pulled kernel logs — see repeated `ENETDOWN`/`link reset` on eni0 on a subset of instances:
```
[ 3050123412.123456] eth0: link up
[ 3050123413.234567] eth0: link down
[ 3050123413.235678] ENI tx dropped: -EIO
[ 3050123414.345678] vxlan: skb dropped, queue full
```

ben: looks like network plane in that AZ is experiencing packet loss and NIC resets. Might be AWS host-level networking problem or a bad hypervisor host group.

oncall-sre: immediate mitigations:
- Drain and cordon impacted instances in us-west-2a (only the ones showing ENI resets)
- Re-register healthy targets from other AZs into the NLB pool to increase capacity
- Temporarily increase burst capacity on Dedicated pools for affected customers (if they have cross-AZ capacity)
- Route new traffic away from us-west-2a via smart-routing for 15m window

alice: starting drain: `kubectl drain node ip-10-12-4-23 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data` for three nodes flagged.

luca: note: draining will drop active KV-cache state for some in-flight inference sessions. We should avoid full cluster-wide drain; prefer targeted deregister + warm start of replacement instances in us-west-2b.

ben: spinning replacement instances in us-west-2b and registering them to the NLB. Also increasing pod replicas on inference deployment with `--zone us-west-2b` placement to absorb burst.

support-bot: Customer "Atlas Payments" reported 503s and retry storms. Their traffic is primarily pinned to us-west-2a; I recommended toggling their routing to us-west-2b in tenant controls and they ack'd.

carla: posting to status page: "Degraded performance for a subset of customers in us-west-2a. Engineering investigating; mitigation underway (traffic steering)."

oncall-sre: monitoring — error rate fell from 18% -> 7% after steering started. Latency p95 reduced to ~220ms. Still higher than baseline.

alice: investigating cause deeper — seeing `eni_reset` pattern correlated with host-level kernel logs mentioning `vf_net` and `tx timeout`. Opening support case with AWS (case 1234567890) and sharing kernel logs.

luca: for immediate resilience we should enable model fallback to smaller quantized variant for affected hosts to reduce CPU/network pressure on retries. Can someone trigger a canary rollout?

ben: initiating canary that serves `redwood-mini-quant` in us-west-2b and us-west-2a replacement instances only. Canary config: 5% traffic -> `redwood-mini-quant` and auto-fallback on 5xx.

carla: coordinating with Customer Success to call two top-impacted customers and confirm no data loss. They prefer regional failover; CS will help toggle route if needed.

oncall-sre: AWS replied on the support case: "We see fiber rebalancing events in a subset of hosts in us-west-2a leading to transient link resets. We recommend migrating/moving instances off affected placement groups." They requested instance IDs; provided.

alice: continuing node drains: replaced 6 nodes so far. NLB target count stable. Error rate now ~2.5% and trending down.

support-bot: Customer "Muse Analytics" posted about truncated streaming outputs. Sent them guidance to retry with exponential backoff and we applied per-tenant rate limiting soft cap to reduce congestion.

carla: status page update: "Mitigation in progress; traffic being routed away from impacted AZ. Partial restoration expected in 30–60m." :hourglass_flowing_sand:

ben: running quick smoke tests for key endpoints. Streaming now reconnects reliably with the canary model serving.

luca: action items for postmortem:
- correlate ENI resets to AWS host events + placement group mapping
- improve cross-AZ session stickiness policy so tenants can switch AZs faster
- add automated fallback to quantized model when node-level network degradation detected
- run chaos test for AZ-level ENI drops to validate graceful degrade path

oncall-sre: handing off to day oncall. Please follow up in #incidents with the postmortem once complete. Closing this pager for now — monitoring continues. :white_check_mark:

carla: will send customer follow-ups and compile timeline. Thanks all. :heart:

luca: filing logs into the incident bundle: `s3://redwood-incident-logs/3050123456/` and attaching case to AWS ticket.

alice: final check: error rate back to baseline ~0.4%, latency p95 95ms. marking as resolved for now.

pagerbot: RESOLVED: High 5xx rate (inference-api) in us-west-2a — incident mitigated and traffic routed.
